detail.longDescription:
Scrolling on a break feels like rest. For me it was half-rest, so I stopped.

When I hit a wall now, I either work or do nothing. Nothing means staring at a wall for 10 to 15 minutes.

I also dropped headphones and background music, and I run a 20-20-20 timer: Every 20 minutes, I look 20 feet away for 20 seconds.

This week I've been noticeably more focused.

#productivity #focus
